name: sabo-platform
description: SABO Dairy Platform — Fullstack Monorepo (Next.js Frontend + NestJS Backend with React Vite Admin Panel)

scripts.dev: node ./node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -n frontend,backend,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix backend/admin"
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build:all: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend/admin
scripts.build:backend: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend

author: SABO Team
